=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text d0 "1 5 3 7 2"
text d1 "5 3 7 2 6 4 5 9 1 2"
text d2 "2 6 3 5 2 8 1 4 2 2 5 3 5 7 4 1"
text d3 "5 5 5 5"
text d4 "5 6 7 8"
text d5 "8 7 7 6"
text d6 "6 7 10 7 6"
text twater "water: "
global vals long 16
global lmax long 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note parse reads the decimal numbers in s (separated by spaces, an optional - sign) into vals and
note returns how many; one pass over s, so the loop is bounded by len s
fn parse s view uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
for i ulong len s
c = get s i
if eq c 45
sg = long -1
else
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 long sub c 48
dig = true
else
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
end
end
end
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
ret n
end
note show writes vals[0..n-1] separated by spaces, then a newline
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get vals i
end
emit nl
end
note water: a column holds min(highest to its left, highest to its right) minus its own height;
note lmax[i] is the running maximum from the left, the right maximum is kept while walking back
fn water n ulong to long
m = long 0
for i ulong n
if gt get vals i m
m = get vals i
end
put lmax i m
end
r = long 0
w = long 0
for x ulong n
i = sub sub n x 1
if gt get vals i r
r = get vals i
end
h = get lmax i
if lt r h
h = r
end
w = add w sub h get vals i
end
ret w
end
fn main to int
n = parse d0
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d1
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d2
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d3
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d4
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d5
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
n = parse d6
show n
emit twater
emiti water n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>

water: 35
5 5 5 5
water: 0
5 6 7 8
water: 0
8 7 7 6
water: 0
6 7 10 7 6
water: 0
</pre>
